description: This file defines the OrderByList class, which manages a list of order-by items for database queries, including methods for adding, checking, and generating SQL order by strings, as well as comparing entities based on the specified order.

classes.name: OrderByList
classes.description: A list managing multiple order-by items for entity queries, providing functionality for adding items, validation against entity models, generating SQL strings, and comparison of entities based on the specified order.

methods.name: addOrderBy
methods.description: Adds one or multiple order-by items from strings, collections, or EntityConditionValues to the list.

methods.name: checkOrderBy
methods.description: Validates the order-by items against a given model entity.

methods.name: makeOrderByString
methods.description: Generates SQL ORDER BY clause string based on the list of order-by items.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two GenericEntity objects based on the order-by criteria.
